header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH BENCH AT SUKKUR
[Waseem Akram v. P.O Sindh and others]
For Petitioner : Mr. Achar Khan Gabol, Advocate
For Respondents : M/s. Ali Raza Balouch & Israr
body: Andan Iqbal Chaudhry J.- In the recruitment process held in the year 2024, the petitioner was selected for the post of Police Constable in the Sindh Police, District Ghotki on the deceased quota. However, upon the requisite medical screening test, he was found to be “HBs Ag Reactive” prone to Hepatitis “B” virus and, therefore, his selection was withdrawn. Pursuant to order dated 28.08.2024, passed in this petition, the petitioner was re-screened for the virus. Again, he tested „Reactive‟. This fact is noted in the order dated 10.10.2024.
Learned counsel for the petitioner yet again prays for a third screening test.

The recruitment process of 2024, during which the petitioner was tested for Hepatitis “B”, and was declared unfit, has since concluded. We are not inclined to re-open the same by way of repeating the re-screening exercise for that would be a discrimination with other candidates similarly placed who were declined. However, we agree with learned counsel that the petitioner having been recommended for appointment on the deceased quota, he will be at liberty to apply afresh as and when he is cured from the virus provided fresh vacancies are advertised. With that observation, the petition is dismissed.
J U D G E J U D G E M.Ali*
